name: Pikes Peak Marathon

location.name: Manitou Springs, CO
location.address: 441 Manitou Ave, Suite 100, Manitou Springs, CO 80829

description: A grueling 13.3 mile trail race from downtown Manitou Springs to the 14,115 foot summit of Pikes Peak via the historic Barr Trail. Features a vertical climb of 7,800 feet with an average 11% grade, winding through pine and aspen forests before climbing above tree line into alpine views. Registration opens March 1, 2027 at 5:00 AM MST with tiered pricing starting at $175.
